desc: Define DP states, initialization, transitions, and terminal conditions for runs of minimum length 3.
Optimize switching transitions across the 26 letters to keep runtime suitable for \(n \le 5\cdot10^4\).
Correct the completed-run switch recurrence and ensure reconstruction matches the DP.
Design suffix-based greedy reconstruction that returns the lexicographically smallest minimum-cost caption.
Implement `Solution.minCostGoodCaption` with safe handling of impossible states and \(n<3\).
Test examples `"cdcd"`, `"aca"`, and `"bc"`, plus single-run, alphabet-boundary, and short-input cases.
